# The treegrafter Fixture

PANTHER 19's TreeGrafter library cut to 3 whole families, PTHR11034, PTHR11442, PTHR18976, with their lines of PAINT annotation release 2026-08-28. The engine's tests prepare it with EBI's `prepare` into a temporary data folder, and graft against it. With `hmmsearch -Z` fixed, a protein whose best family is one of these gets the full library's numbers.

Generated by `panther-engine treegrafter data fixture`, never edited by hand: rebuilding it from the pinned library and release gives the same bytes. From `engine/`, with both fetched:

```sh
uv run panther-engine treegrafter data fixture --data-dir ../.data --release 2026-08-28 \
  --annotation-file PAINT_TreeGrafter_Annotations_TOTAL.txt.gz \
  --out tests/fixtures/treegrafter PTHR11034 PTHR11442 PTHR18976
```

- **The library:** `https://data.pantherdb.org/ftp/downloads/TreeGrafter/PANTHER19.0_data_trees_hmms_only.tar.gz`, sha256 `789c31d7f1e051ae3dfdd4c6c41e97a970395cc490cab52da850d1b5abfd5e4f`.
- **The release:** `https://data.pantherdb.org/ftp/downloads/paint/19.0/2026-08-28/PAINT_TreeGrafter_Annotations_TOTAL.txt.gz`, sha256 `03ad195b42a48ff2fb0caadd337bf2c98464382855618c1f14fe2869b3d6bf3f`, GO release 2026-08-05.
